icaro.prompt_integral: Produce ONE transparent pixel-art sprite: Ícaro southwest walking cycle, phase 08. Reference 1 fixes character identity, palette, silhouette, scale and camera. Reference 2 is a schematic of PHASE 08 only: orange = anatomical left leg swinging forward, blue = anatomical right leg supporting. Reference 3 is approved adjacent phase 07 and defines the supporting RIGHT leg and its shoe, which must continue from its screen-left floor contact around x153,y480 to the next floor contact around x190-200,y480 without a jump to the screen-right shoe. Reference 4 is the defective current 08 for head/torso/accessory continuity; REDRAW BOTH COMPLETE LEGS from hips to shoes rather than repositioning a shoe fragment. Right leg is planted near center, knee naturally bent, shoe fully connected; left leg swings through center with toe slightly raised near x200-215,y450 and does not touch ground. The two shoes are close but distinct. Keep head, hair, face, tank, shoulders, arms and yellow watch as near reference 4 as possible. No body shift, no scaling, no mirror, no extra limb, no blur, no painted floor or shadow. Hard pixel edges, full body in RGBA cell 384x512 with anchor (192,480).
icaro.decisao: rejeitado: reproduziu a abertura das pernas, com duas solas baixas; apoio direito e balanço esquerdo não seguem o guia nem a continuidade 07→08
